info.title: Hinode Automotive ERP — custom methods
info.description: Whitelisted methods of the custom apps, called as Frappe methods: `POST /api/method/<path>` (JSON or form body) or `GET` with query parameters where allowed; the result is in `message`. Authenticate with a session (portal and desk users; send the CSRF token in `X-Frappe-CSRF-Token`) or an API key (`Authorization: token <key>:<secret>`). `x-roles` lists the roles a method requires; `x-party` marks partner-portal methods scoped to the caller's own supplier or dealer. State-changing partner and MES methods require an `Idempotency-Key`. Partner systems send messages to the signed inbound endpoint (`automotive_core.integration_hub.inbound.receive`). Generated by scripts/dev/openapi.py.
